title: Replacing the process
hints: syscall.Exec(path, argv, env) passes argv to the new program exactly as given, and the program sees it as os.Args. Its first element must be the program name.
Here argv starts with the first real argument, so the new program thinks it is called "alpha" and sees only ["beta"] as arguments.
Pass append([]string{tool}, args...) as argv. Exec returns only if it fails.
